name: Open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards
description: Job postings pulled from public ATS job-board APIs: title, department, location, workplace type and posted salary range where disclosed.

license.name: Free to use, source terms apply

dataOrigin: Public Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby job-board APIs

columns.name: company
columns.description: Company name.

columns.name: companySlug
columns.description: Company slug on the ATS board.

columns.name: ats
columns.description: ATS platform: greenhouse, lever or ashby.

columns.name: jobId
columns.description: Job identifier at the source platform.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title or headline of the record.

columns.name: department
columns.description: Department or team.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Location text as published.

columns.name: remote
columns.description: True when the posting is flagged remote.

columns.name: workplaceType
columns.description: onsite, hybrid or remote where given.

columns.name: employmentType
columns.description: Employment type such as FULL_TIME.

columns.name: postedAt
columns.description: Posting time (UTC).

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Last update time (UTC).

columns.name: applyUrl
columns.description: Application link.

columns.name: jobUrl
columns.description: Public job page link.

columns.name: salaryMin
columns.description: Lower end of the posted salary range (number, in salaryCurrency per salaryPeriod). Empty when not disclosed.

columns.name: salaryMax
columns.description: Upper end of the posted salary range. Empty when not disclosed.

columns.name: salaryCurrency
columns.description: ISO currency code of the salary range.

columns.name: salaryPeriod
columns.description: Period the salary range covers (for example year or hour).

columns.name: descriptionText
columns.description: Start of the job description (truncated to 300 characters).

columns.name: sourceUrl
columns.description: URL of the source feed or portal page the row came from.

columns.name: seniority
columns.description: Seniority level inferred from the title.

columns.name: scrapedAt
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the actor fetched the row.
